verdict.rationale: The product is an on-phone iPhone app where you type a goal and press Start. The closest evidence is that saved tasks can be triggered via Siri, Shortcuts, widgets or Control Center and run in the background. That is on-device triggering, not a documented headless mode or CI integration. The Mac-side board_test.py script is a hardware debugging tool, not a way to run the agent unattended in a pipeline.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
